have been a patient at this practice for 16 years and I am so glad I am.
I have been lucky and enjoyed good health up to about 4 years ago.
I have been off work since September with severe arthritis pain due to bone on bone in knee and hip complicated by Spondylitis in my spine this was complicated by stress and anxiety due to a lot of external factors.
Trilinks is a training practice so newly trained doctors come and go and it was Dr Mosabbeh who initially helped me when I first became ill.
He arranged for urgent referral for my arthritis, counselling, sick notes etc and spent time talking with me to understand what was going on and to ensure I received the correct ongoing treatment....lovely man who I have no doubt will be an excellent GP.
Since then I have received excellent support and help from the doctors and some of the reception/ practice team.
Had a bit of a blip when my first operation was unexpectedly cancelled and I spent 2 weeks trying to get a new referral but once he knew what was going on, Dr Singhu soon sorted it out.
My sincere thanks goes to everyone at the practice and all of the doctors there.
It's always easy to criticise but Dr Singhu gives newly trained doctors the much needed opportunities to get general practice experience and he runs an excellent practice.
